is: One module per domain namespace exposing a `clap::Subcommand` enum plus `run(&Runtime, op) -> Result<Value, CliError>`; the root dispatch in `lib.rs` routes to it. `migrate` is the exception: `run` hands it the custody migrator and its flags (`MigrateArgs`), not a runtime.

fs.name: account.rs
fs.role: account namespace — create/delete, thin CLI face over runtime.app().accounts().{create, delete}, delete gated by crate::confirm

fs.name: bug_reports.rs
fs.role: bug-reports list — operator read over runtime.app().bug_reports().list; the Listed projection rendered as fenced, escaped text (Display) or ASCII-only JSON (AsciiFormatter); tests in bug_reports/tests.rs

fs.name: health.rs
fs.role: zurfur health — same probe as GET /health via adapter_pg::is_reachable plus latency

fs.name: migrate.rs
fs.role: zurfur migrate — runs the custody migrator `Runtime::connect_migrating` hands back (holding DID custody): probe, migrations, re-wrap; reports `applied`, `version`, `rowsRewrapped`. `--check` runs only `check()`, reporting `unopenable` and `pending` without writing. A root any custody row (a 0.1 ciphertext or an envelope) doesn't open under is a `config` refusal naming a count; exempt from the schema-drift gate

fs.name: session.rs
fs.role: session namespace — whoami/logout read/clear the identity file; login stubbed not_implemented pending a client-model decision
